- Search for several things at once. Type a word in the find box, right-click it, and choose **Add Search** to keep it highlighted in yellow while you type the next one.
- Choose **Add Search custom color** to pick one of eight preset colors, or **More colors…** to use any color. Add the same word again to change its color.
- Added searches appear as purple bubbles under the match count with their color, match count, and an **×** to remove them. There is no limit on how many you can add.
- Bubbles are packed to fit as many as possible on each row. When they need more than one row, click **more ▾** under the find box to show them all and **Less ▴** to fold them back.
- The arrows, Enter, F3, **Lock**, and search markers cover every added search, and added searches carry over as you change chapters.

For Windows x64, extract the portable ZIP and open **Folio Reader.exe**. To upgrade an existing copy, close Folio and replace the executable and loader DLL in your current Folio folder.
